title: Naan
instructions: Add all the ingredients to a stand mixer bowl with a dough hook.
Mix on low for about 8 minutes.
Cover the bowl and let it sit at room temperature for 1-2 hours until the dough has doubled in size.
Weigh and divide the dough into 6 equal parts, or make two ~250 gram dough balls for pizza.
Roll each part into a flat bread. If making pizza, stretch dough ball out into a 10-11 inch pizza base.
Heat a cast iron skillet on medium-high heat.
When the skillet is hot, place the flattened naan into the pan.
Allow the naan to bubble for 3-4 minutes (covered or uncovered) before flipping.
Finish with ghee and serve. Any extra naan can be refrigerated for upto 3 days.
